# openai_mcp_tunnel (Resource)

Manage an MCP tunnel registration. Requires access to the Tunnels API and an organization admin API key. Manages the name and description; associated organizations, workspaces, and tenants are read-only. Creation associates the authenticated organization or workspace. Deploy and authenticate the tunnel client separately; this resource does not issue credentials.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_mcp_tunnel" "example" {
  name        = "private-mcp-server"
  description = "Private MCP server for the organization."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Tunnel description. Use an empty string to clear it.
- `name` (String) Human-readable tunnel name.

### Read-Only

- `creator` (String) Identifier of the principal that created the tunnel.
- `id` (String) Tunnel identifier.
- `organization_ids` (List of String) Organization identifiers associated with the tunnel.
- `tenant_ids` (List of String) Tenant identifiers associated with the tunnel.
- `workspace_ids` (List of String) Workspace identifiers associated with the tunnel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_mcp_tunnel.example
  id = "tunnel_00000000000000000000000000000001"
}
```
